Properties

AdvancedCollisionNotifications

This determines if ColliderIntersected and ColliderOverlapped will be called and if OnColliderOverlapped and OnColliderIntersected events will be invoked. Collision and CollisionEnded will always be called. This is an additional convenience option to get overlap/intersection information in a different way.

public bool AdvancedCollisionNotifications { get; set; }
